sound.detail: The mostly coherent ASR draft explains real-time rendering, emotional responses, listening, behavioral training and identity consistency. Example dialogue includes reluctance to discuss family and an accepting reply, job-loss context and a light fashion exchange. It ends with platform/API availability and tavus.io, though brand/model names have recognition errors. These words support script structure, not heard naturalness, lip sync, latency or clinical value.

lessons.keep: Use short labels and targeted callouts to focus attention on subtle output behavior.
lessons.avoid: Avoid making viewers infer the cause and timing of a reaction from an expressive face alone.
lessons.open: Conversational timing, lip sync, comparative fairness, model execution, long-run consistency and all heard audio properties remain unverified.
try: For Tin, pair one input sentence with a labelled output change and a visible timeline.
